scope: Deploy three evidence-labelled camp Forean companions for Capture the Flag, mission 1994

build.method: Derived only the companion runtime source, capability declaration, two migration pairs and their data-row files from the previously deployed Game image; dotnet build --no-restore succeeded with six pre-existing warnings and zero errors. Auth image unchanged.

isolated_verification.database: SQLite backup API copies of the three live databases; source hashes in /home/blizz/backups/rasa-net/deployments/20260923-camp-companion-candidate/isolated/copy-manifest.json
isolated_verification.result: Both migrations applied; creature 198516-198518 and placement 198688-198690 rows present; world integrity_check=ok. First candidate boot exposed a missing CombatCompanion capability declaration and withheld the three placements. Corrected derived image boot loaded 409 content rows with zero gaps and no companion-withheld warning.
isolated_verification.focused_tests: Four PlacedCreatureBehaviorTests passed under the .NET 5 SDK container: guard post, guard aggro, companion leash near player, and companion assist against an enemy without targeting a player. Host test runner failed for missing libssl; container run succeeded.

deployment.startup: Game loaded 17 content rules, 409 content rows, zero gaps; boot camp entry AllowListedAccounts; listened on port 8102, connected and authenticated to Auth at 2026-09-24 01:19:31 UTC. Game and Auth restart counts zero immediately after deployment.

limits: The original final-week video identifies these ally types, but their individual camp positions, health, speed, attacks and precise activation remain estimates recorded field by field in the source manifests.

A later isolated original-client replay on the exact deployed Game binary shows the three companions rendered at camp, following across the upper gap in one run and each damaging a Thrax in a controlled one-enemy run; see docs/evidence/bootcamp-live-companion-binary-client-replay.json. A normal six-Thrax completion remains unverified.

The separate level-2 courtyard Forean Warrior was deliberately excluded. The staged one-Warrior encounter contradicts the recorded fight sequence; see docs/evidence/bootcamp-courtyard-warrior-sequence-audit.json.
